name: Noah
description: Flood survivor living at the time before the Flood

points: Methuselah lived nine hundred sixty and nine years: he lived the longest ever of a man. And Lamech begat a son, and he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord hath cursed: when Adam sinned, the Lord cursed the ground and made things hard for them to cultivate.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Noah was five hundred years old here, and he was six hundred when the flood came (Genesis 7:6), so Noah preached for around a hundred years, give or take.

note.label: Genesis 5: The Book of the Generations of Adam

points: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord. Noah was exceptional.

So why did he only tell Noah to build the ark? Why did he not tell everybody else? He only told Noah. Same thing with Abraham. He only told Abraham destruction was coming. The Lord kept it a secret. The same way with us, what we know is a secret. These Christian churches, Methodist, Baptist, they do not know destruction is coming. He looked at everybody on the earth, and only Noah found grace in his eyes. He looked at everybody in those five cities and said, we are only going to tell Abraham what is going on.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations. He was keeping the commandments. And Noah walked with God. And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord. Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations: Noah was also a son of God, and out of all the sons of God in that time doing wickedness, messing around with Cain and them, Noah did not. There's always that light that shines in that darkness all throughout time. Righteous and perfect and just, meaning keeping God's commandments; the commandments that Seth kept, he was keeping also. And Noah walked with God.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord; he was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

note.label: Genesis 6: The Sons of God and the Preparing of the Ark

points: And the earth was filled with violence. And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth. And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth. Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: The earth was filled with violence through them: that them goes back to Cain's seed. Cain's seed was influencing everybody; what we read in Genesis 4 about Cain's children affected all people on the earth. So God told Noah, Make thee an ark of gopher wood.

note.label: Religion - The False Prophet

points: Noah did all that the Most High commanded him by faith. Up to that time rain had never been seen; it takes faith to build an ark for a thing that has never happened.
While the ark was preparing, Noah was a preacher of righteousness, telling his people to repent, and the longsuffering of the Most High waited for them to repent.

As Noah prepared the ark to the saving of his house, we must prepare our households for when Christ comes back; that takes the same faith. In the days of Noah they were eating, drinking, and marrying until Noah entered the ark and there was no more chance to repent; so shall the coming of the Son of man be. We have to put on the spirit of Noah.

note.label: Genesis 6: The Sons of God and the Preparing of the Ark

points: Look at the mind of God for destruction. If over a hundred thousand Palestinians and more than a thousand Iranians dead sounds bad, revisit the flood, where there were no righteous except the ones on the ark. The Lord said unto Noah, come thou and all thy house into the ark, for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation: he got the orders on how to build it and did it faithfully.

note.label: Wars Are Here: Seek Good Not Evil

points: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth: so 100 years later, Noah built that boat and got in that boat.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: We read this all the time, but you don't understand what Noah dealt with. There's babies out there. People: please, my baby, please. Screaming and crying. His family out there too; Noah had siblings, sons and daughters out there screaming: why are you doing this? Noah had to sit there and take it, hear the screaming, the crying, the begging, until you hear nothing no more. That's a terrible thing to experience, man.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Of them that dwelt in the world only Noah and his household were left, of whom came all righteous men: through Shem's seed to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and through their line the Israelites.

note.label: Genesis 7: The First Rain and the Flood

points: Noah and his sons were told to replenish the earth after the flood, and the earth is replenished with righteous children; a multitude of ungodly children profits nothing.

note.label: Genesis 9: The Laws Before Moses and the Covenant of the Bow

points: Noah was asleep, so how did he know what his younger son had done? The Most High speaks to man in a dream, in a vision of the night, and reveals His secret unto His servants the prophets; Noah was a preacher of righteousness, and the Lord told him.

note.label: Genesis 9: The Laws Before Moses and the Covenant of the Bow

points: The line from the first man is set down in order: Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahalaleel, Jered, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah, and the three sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me. This is the Lord speaking through Isaiah.
For as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth. So he promised the waters of Noah would no more go over the earth.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth, so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee. The Lord flooded the earth and made a vow with the rainbow that he would never flood the earth again. Likewise, he will never put us in captivity again once we get delivered. You will not see slavery ever again. You're going to be ruling forever. This is the last go around. No more of this captivity stuff.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness. That's what Noah did, his wife did, his sons did, and their wives did: saved themselves by their own righteousness. Likewise Daniel, likewise Job.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness.

note.label: Ezekiel 14: Idols in the Heart and the Four Sore Judgments

points: But as the days of Noe were. That is the Greek, by the way. N-o-e is still Noah. So shall also the coming of the Son of man be. Meaning Christ.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: Until the day that Noe entered into the ark. So what was Noah doing? He was warning the people to repent, change their ways. The scripture calls him a preacher of righteousness.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man. So he takes you all the way back to Noah's time. When Christ comes back, it is going to be the same way it was in Noah's time.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark. They were clueless about what was going on. And the flood came, and destroyed them all.

note.label: When God Reveals His Secrets!

points: As it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man. They did eat, they drank, they married wives, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all. Likewise in the days of Lot: life as usual, until the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet: what things were unseen? Heavy rain for 40 days and 40 nights, the whole earth being flooded, everyone dead on earth. That's unseen, unheard of. The Lord said, listen, Noah, I'm gonna kill everybody: get the animals, clean and unclean, get your wife, your sons and their wives, get in the boat, let's go. No problem, Lord. He had no questions; he was faithful like Abraham was.

Moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world: because Noah got saved and everybody else didn't. And became heir of the righteousness which is by faith: Noah kept the commandments of God, and by faith he built that boat. That was his works; his faith was proven by him building the ark in the first place. Faith without works is dead.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: When once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah: the Lord gave a hundred year time span for the people to repent.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Tobit's charge to his son: beware of all whoredom, take a wife of the seed of thy fathers and not a strange woman, for Noah, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob all married wives of their own kindred and their seed shall inherit the land.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father's tribe: for we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred. What did they do? Married wives of their own kindred. And were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: For we are the children of the prophets: Noah, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, including Noah. Noah didn't marry daughters of men; he married his own kind, a daughter of God, and his sons' wives are their own kind. Noah did not step outside of that. He did not do what the sons of God were doing, go out and mess with Cain's daughters. He was like, nah, I'mma keep the laws of God and marry my own.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of thy fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of thy father's tribe. The Most High calls marrying a strange woman whoredom. We are the children of the prophets Noah, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob; our fathers from the beginning all married wives of their own kindred and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.
